artifacts.observations.txt:
S4 sanitized observations, 2026-08-22

1. /dashboard/mitm — expandable MITM cards
Live DOM: Antigravity, GitHub Copilot, and Kiro card headers are visually clickable containers. Each has role=null and tabIndex=-1; only the Start Server button appears in the accessibility action inventory. Pointer expansion is available; Tab/Enter cannot reach or activate the headers.
Screenshot: mitm-cards-keyboard.webp
Console: none. Network: owned GET status only; no mutation executed.

2. /dashboard/mitm — Start Server confirmation boundary
After the real status GET completed, pointer activation opened “Sudo Password Required.” Live DOM had one password input and Cancel/Confirm buttons, but document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]').length was 0. Focus remained on the background Start Server trigger. Escape did not dismiss; Cancel did. Confirm was not executed.
Console: none. Network: no Start/Stop/Trust/DNS mutation executed.

3. /dashboard/profile — Shutdown confirmation boundary
Pointer activation after scroll opened title “Shutdown” and message “Are you sure you want to close the proxy server?” with Cancel/Shutdown buttons. Live DOM had role=dialog count 0 and focus remained on the background Shutdown trigger. Escape dismissed. Confirm was not executed.
Console: none. Network: no shutdown request executed.

4. /dashboard/settings/pricing — Pricing Configuration modal
Pointer activation opened Pricing Configuration. role=dialog count was 0; focus remained on background Edit Pricing. Escape left the modal open; the × close control dismissed it. Five numeric fields had no aria-label and no associated label element. Submitting -1 was blocked by native validation; no pricing write occurred.
Console: none. Network: no pricing mutation executed.

5. /dashboard/translator — malformed and empty editor actions
Using the visible Monaco surface, the Client Request was replaced with {bad and Format was activated. The malformed payload remained; there was no toast, non-empty role=alert, aria-live message, or inline error. Content was then cleared. Activating Send with the empty request produced no request and no toast/alert/inline validation.
Console: none. Network: no provider request and no external traffic.

6. /dashboard/console-log — synthetic disconnected state
CDP blocked only /api/translator/console-logs/stream, then the route was reloaded. The failed resource had duration=0 and transferSize=0. UI text remained “Clear / No console logs yet”; role=alert and role=status were empty. Block was removed and the real route restored. This is a client error-state observation, not a backend defect.
Console: none.

7. S4 switch accessibility
Live accessibility tree exposed unnamed switches on /dashboard/profile (Round Robin, Combo Round Robin, Outbound Proxy, Observability) and /dashboard/token-saver (RTK, Headroom, Caveman, Ponytail, Conversation Vault): aria-label=null and no accessible text on each role=switch. Agent-library enablement checkboxes likewise lacked programmatic names.

8. State restoration
Fake HOME tree SHA-256 before and after: ee6b583af202d0bdbdc1a69632458464036b92552cf439f9330bb764979ef6b7 (4 files; identical manifest). Isolated settings verified restored: requireApiKey=true, locale English, theme localStorage dark, comboStrategies seed values, outboundProxyEnabled=false with blank URL/no-proxy, observability=true, RTK=true, Headroom/Caveman/Ponytail=false, Caveman/Ponytail level=full, vault=true threshold=8. No MITM/Headroom/Doctor/host/update/shutdown/catalog-install mutation ran.
